evd_title: Best NLP model MultiVerS top-20 achieved micro-F1 0.59 and macro-F1 0.52 on citation accuracy classification
finding: Best NLP model MultiVerS top-20 achieved micro-F1 0.59 and macro-F1 0.52 on citation accuracy classification
P: Held-out test citations from Sarol corpus (100 PMC-OA biomedical refs, 3063 citations)
I: MultiVerS (Longformer) fine-tuned on HealthVER + Sarol train; BM25+MonoT5 top-20 evidence retrieval
C: GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 and GPT-4 (in-context learning, top-5 evidence); other MultiVerS variants; oracle conditions
O: MultiVerS top-20: macro-F1 0.52 vs GPT-4 0.45, GPT-3.5 0.38; micro-F1 0.59 vs GPT-4 0.65, GPT-3.5 0.57; N_ACC F1 0.43 vs GPT-4 0.09 (PDF Table 4)
